name: Neptune
source: Neptune, also known as Purple Heart, is one of the four Console Patron Units (CPUs) in Hyperdimension Neptunia: Producing Perfection who shares have been negatively affected by the sudden idol boom in Gamindustri. She, along with the other CPUs decide to become idols in order to regain their shares.
